description: Defines the ShippingSummary class which encapsulates the details of shipping costs and options, including shipping fees, handling fees, shipping module, options, and flags for free shipping and tax applicability.

classes.name: ShippingSummary
classes.description: A class that models shipping cost summaries including fees, module, options, and flags for free shipping and tax on shipping.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping fee as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getHandling
methods.description: Returns the handling fee as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getShippingModule
methods.description: Returns the shipping module as a String.

methods.name: getShippingOption
methods.description: Returns the shipping option as a String.

methods.name: isFreeShipping
methods.description: Indicates if the shipping is free.

methods.name: isTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Indicates if tax applies on shipping.

methods.name: setTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Sets the tax on shipping flag.
